results.statement: Every stock in NSE's own daily file for the latest session is in our price panel, with the same closing price to the paisa.
results.threshold: coverage >= 99.5%, 0 BE/BZ series regressions, 0 closing-price mismatches

results.statement: Every input the pipeline reads is younger than its declared maximum age, file by file and column by column.
results.threshold: 0 stale files, 0 stale columns

results.statement: Each stock has at most one row per trading day in the price panel.
results.threshold: 0 duplicate (symbol, date) rows

results.statement: None of the last 20 sessions is a copy of the session before it.
results.threshold: no session with >= 90% of rows repeating the prior session

results.statement: Corporate actions were refreshed before prices in the latest daily run.
results.threshold: corp_actions passed and appears before prices

results.statement: Every derived table the strategy reads has a manifest that states its units and its source.
results.threshold: all listed tables have a manifest with units or columns described

results.statement: No quarterly result is dated as filed before its quarter ended, and no order filing is dated after we fetched it.
results.threshold: 0 violations
results.detail: P&L filed before quarter end: 0; orders dated after fetch: 0

results.statement: The model scores used by this week's screen are at most 7 days old.
results.threshold: <= 7 calendar days

results.statement: Every row in the datasets built from government sources carries the URL it came from and the date it was published.
results.threshold: 0 rows without a source URL or a publication date

results.statement: Every order amount we report can be found, as written, in the filing text it was extracted from.
results.threshold: >= 98% of amounts grounded (number x its written unit reproduces the stored crore value within 2%)

results.statement: On the most recent fully labelled year, the model's weekly top-10 liquid picks touch +50% at least 1.5 times as often as the average liquid stock.
results.threshold: lift >= 1.5

results.statement: Every experiment with a result in the log was registered earlier, with its pass rule, before the result was written.
results.threshold: 0 results without an earlier registration (experiments from 2026-09-27 on)

results.statement: A weekly screen, once saved, is never rewritten.
results.threshold: 0 changed screens

results.statement: Each track has at most one screen per calendar week.
results.threshold: 0 weeks with more than one screen

results.statement: Every open paper batch was scored through the latest session.
results.threshold: all open batches scored through the last session (entry-pending batches excepted)

results.statement: The daily data run finished for the latest weekday.
results.threshold: status date = the latest weekday that has NSE data
results.detail: expected a run for 2026-09-29 (NSE holidays not yet excluded)

results.statement: The latest Google Drive backup matches its manifest checksums, file by file.
results.threshold: all volumes match

results.statement: When Claude states a number to Abhinav, that number appears in a file, a command output or his own message from the same session.
results.threshold: 5% or fewer of numbers without a receipt over the last 7 days
results.detail: no replies logged by the Stop hook in the last 7 days (hook loads on a new session)

results.statement: Re-running each registered test from the committed code gives the logged numbers again.
results.threshold: every test REPRODUCED (within 0.1 point) or DRIFTED (within 1 point after a data refresh); re-checked within 35 days

results.statement: A fresh Claude session answers the golden questions about this system correctly, including saying 'that does not exist' to trap questions.
results.threshold: 90% or more correct on the latest run
results.detail: no golden run yet (needs the claude CLI logged in)

results.statement: On a sample of 50 investor-deck filings graded by a person, the extracted figure is the filing's total order book at least 80% of the time.
results.threshold: >= 80% correct (within 5% of the stated total book)

results.statement: Before real money moves, a person has read each weekly batch and signed off that no pick is a takeover target, carries a fraud or governance red flag, or has an unexplained price spike.
results.threshold: a signed review exists for the latest batch of each track
